# Dr. Rajesh Reddy Sannareddy - Brain, Spine & Endovascular Neurosurgeon

> Dr. Rajesh Reddy Sannareddy (M.Ch Neurosurgery, FINR Zurich, Switzerland) is a Senior Consultant Neurosurgeon based in Hyderabad, India, with over 15 years of surgical experience and 5,000+ successful neurosurgical and neurointerventional procedures. He specializes in brain tumor surgery, awake craniotomy, minimally invasive brain and spine surgery, aneurysm coiling and clipping, stroke intervention, and complex spinal trauma.

Practice Location: Medicover Hospital, Financial District, Hyderabad, Telangana 500032, India.
Contact: Phone/WhatsApp: +91-8520052229 | Email: info@drrajeshreddy.com | Website: https://drrajeshreddy.com
Patient Mobile App ("Dr. Reddy's Neuro Care"):
- iOS App Store: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/dr-reddys-neuro-care/id6753586620
- Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.docterz.connect.drreddysneurocare

## Core Clinical Expertise
- **Brain Tumors & Neuro-Oncology**: Awake craniotomy, glioma surgery, meningioma, pituitary adenomas (endoscopic transsphenoidal), and minimally invasive tumor resection.
- **Neurovascular & Endovascular Neurosurgery**: Brain aneurysms (coiling, clipping, flow diversion), arteriovenous malformations (AVM), stroke thrombectomy, and subarachnoid hemorrhage (SAH).
- **Spine Surgery & Trauma**: Minimally invasive spine surgery (MISS), cervical & thoracolumbar fracture stabilization, kyphoplasty/vertebroplasty, spinal cord decompression, and degenerative spine care.

## Brain Tumor & Neuro-Oncology Services
- [Brain Tumor Removal Surgery](https://drrajeshreddy.com/brain-tumor-removal-surgery): Precision microsurgical excision using intraoperative neuro-monitoring, neuronavigation, and functional brain preservation.
- [Brain Tumor Types & Classification](https://drrajeshreddy.com/brain-tumor-types): Guide to primary vs. secondary tumors, benign vs. malignant brain lesions, and grading systems.
- [Brain Tumor Symptoms](https://drrajeshreddy.com/brain-tumor-symptoms): Early signs, localized neurological deficits, seizures, chronic morning headaches, and vision changes.
- [Glioma Surgery in Hyderabad](https://drrajeshreddy.com/glioma-surgery-hyderabad): Specialized care for low-grade and high-grade gliomas (glioblastoma) maximizing resection while sparing functional cortex.
- [Meningioma Treatment](https://drrajeshreddy.com/meningioma-treatment): Skull-base and convexity meningioma management, surgical indications, and radiosurgery evaluation.
- [Pituitary Tumor Surgery](https://drrajeshreddy.com/pituitary-tumor-surgery): Minimally invasive endoscopic endonasal transsphenoidal removal of pituitary adenomas with hormone preservation.
- [Awake Craniotomy](https://drrajeshreddy.com/awake-craniotomy): Real-time brain mapping during tumor excision in eloquent speech and motor cortex areas.
- [Minimally Invasive Brain Tumor Surgery](https://drrajeshreddy.com/minimally-invasive-brain-tumor-surgery): Keyhole approaches, neuroendoscopy, reduced tissue disruption, and shortened hospital stays.
- [Brain Tumor Surgery Recovery](https://drrajeshreddy.com/brain-tumor-surgery-recovery): Post-operative timeline, ICU stay, neuro-rehabilitation, speech therapy, and long-term surveillance.

## Neurovascular & Brain Aneurysm Treatments
- [Brain Aneurysm Treatment Overview](https://drrajeshreddy.com/brain-aneurysm-treatment): Dual-trained approach offering both endovascular coiling and microsurgical clipping tailored to anatomy.
- [Brain Aneurysm Warning Symptoms](https://drrajeshreddy.com/brain-aneurysm-symptoms): Identification of sentinel headaches, "thunderclap" headache, cranial nerve compression, and vision changes.
- [Ruptured vs Unruptured Brain Aneurysms](https://drrajeshreddy.com/ruptured-unruptured-brain-aneurysm): Risk stratification, PHASES score assessment, rupture prevention, and emergency intervention.
- [Aneurysm Coiling vs Clipping Comparison](https://drrajeshreddy.com/aneurysm-coiling-vs-clipping): Comprehensive objective guide comparing catheter-based coiling with open surgical clipping.
- [Endovascular Coiling in Hyderabad](https://drrajeshreddy.com/endovascular-coiling-hyderabad): Minimally invasive catheter treatment through the femoral or radial artery with microcoils.
- [Flow Diversion Stenting](https://drrajeshreddy.com/flow-diversion-brain-aneurysm): Advanced endoluminal flow-diverter stent placement for wide-neck, giant, or blister brain aneurysms.
- [AVM (Arteriovenous Malformation) Treatment](https://drrajeshreddy.com/avm-treatment-hyderabad): Multimodal management of brain AVMs via embolization, microsurgical resection, or stereotactic radiosurgery.
- [Brain Stroke Treatment & Mechanical Thrombectomy](https://drrajeshreddy.com/brain-stroke-treatment): Emergency acute ischemic stroke intervention, clot retrieval within golden hour, and stroke ICU care.
- [Subarachnoid Hemorrhage (SAH) Management](https://drrajeshreddy.com/subarachnoid-hemorrhage-treatment): Critical care protocol for aneurysm rupture, hydrocephalus management, and vasospasm prevention.
- [Brain Aneurysm Surgery Recovery Guide](https://drrajeshreddy.com/brain-aneurysm-surgery-recovery): What to anticipate after coiling or clipping, ICU recovery, blood pressure control, and follow-up angiograms.

---

## Spine Surgery & Spinal Trauma
- [Spine Fracture Treatment Overview](https://drrajeshreddy.com/spine-fracture-treatment): Comprehensive diagnosis and management of traumatic, osteoporotic, and pathological spine fractures.
- [Cervical Spine Fracture Treatment](https://drrajeshreddy.com/cervical-spine-fracture-treatment): Neck stabilization, anterior cervical discectomy and fusion (ACDF), posterior cervical fixation, and halo protocols.
- [Thoracolumbar Spine Fracture](https://drrajeshreddy.com/thoracolumbar-spine-fracture): Mid-back and lower-back spinal injury stabilization, pedicle screw fixation, and kyphosis prevention.
- [Minimally Invasive Spine Fracture Surgery](https://drrajeshreddy.com/minimally-invasive-spine-fracture-surgery): Percutaneous screw fixation minimizing muscle damage, blood loss, and recovery time.
- [Pathological Spine Fractures](https://drrajeshreddy.com/pathological-spine-fracture): Management of spine fractures caused by metastatic tumors, multiple myeloma, or severe bone weakness.
- [Spinal Cord Injury Treatment](https://drrajeshreddy.com/spinal-cord-injury-treatment): Urgent decompression, stabilization, neuroprotection, and physical rehabilitation protocols.
- [Vertebroplasty & Kyphoplasty](https://drrajeshreddy.com/vertebroplasty-kyphoplasty): Minimally invasive bone cement augmentation for painful osteoporotic compression fractures.
- [Spine Fracture Recovery Guide](https://drrajeshreddy.com/spine-fracture-recovery): Rehabilitation stages, bracing, physical therapy exercises, and bone mineral density management.

## Patient Education & Neurological Articles
- [Patient Education Hub](https://drrajeshreddy.com/patient-education): Directory of evidence-based health articles explaining neurological conditions in patient-friendly terms.
- [Stroke Management Guidelines](https://drrajeshreddy.com/patient-education/stroke-management-guidelines): Modern clinical guidelines for identifying and managing acute ischemic and hemorrhagic strokes.
- [Blood Clots vs Stroke](https://drrajeshreddy.com/patient-education/blood-clots-vs-stroke): Understanding embolisms, thrombosis, deep vein thrombosis, and stroke mechanics.
- [Stroke in Young Adults](https://drrajeshreddy.com/patient-education/stroke-in-young-adults): Emerging risk factors, carotid dissections, hypercoagulable states, and lifestyle triggers in young patients.
- [Spine Health After 50](https://drrajeshreddy.com/patient-education/spine-health-after-50): Preventive measures, core strengthening, disc degeneration care, and osteoporosis protection.
- [Osteoporotic Spine Fractures](https://drrajeshreddy.com/patient-education/osteoporotic-spine-fractures): Recognizing silent vertebral collapse, DEXA scans, calcium/vitamin D optimization, and cement injection.
- [Surgery for Back Pain FAQ](https://drrajeshreddy.com/patient-education/faq-surgery-for-back-pain): When back pain requires surgery vs when conservative management and physiotherapy suffice.
- [Trigeminal Neuralgia](https://drrajeshreddy.com/patient-education/trigeminal-neuralgia): Managing severe electric-shock facial pain through medications, microvascular decompression (MVD), or radiosurgery.
- [AI in Neurosurgery](https://drrajeshreddy.com/patient-education/ai-in-neurosurgery): How artificial intelligence enhances pre-operative planning, intraoperative image guidance, and surgical accuracy.
- [Intraoperative Neurophysiological Monitoring (IONM)](https://drrajeshreddy.com/patient-education/intraoperative-neurophysiological-monitoring): Safeguarding nerve pathways and spinal cord function in real time during surgery.
- [Is Neurosurgery Safe?](https://drrajeshreddy.com/patient-education/is-neurosurgery-safe): An honest look at modern surgical safety protocols, imaging technology, and complication mitigation.
- [Myths and Facts About Brain Tumors](https://drrajeshreddy.com/patient-education/mythes-and-facts-about-brain-tumors): Debunking pervasive misconceptions regarding diagnosis, curability, and surgical outcomes.
- [The Brain's Blood Supply](https://drrajeshreddy.com/patient-education/brains-blood-supply): Visual and descriptive explanation of the Circle of Willis and cerebrovascular anatomy.
- [When to Worry About Persistent Headaches](https://drrajeshreddy.com/patient-education/when-to-worry-about-persistent-headaches): Red-flag symptoms that indicate a headache needs immediate neurosurgical evaluation.

## Medical Disclaimer
The contents published by Dr. Rajesh Reddy Sannareddy are for educational and informational purposes only and do not constitute formal medical diagnosis, treatment, or doctor-patient privilege. Patients experiencing acute neurological symptoms (thunderclap headache, sudden weakness, speech slurring, vision loss, or seizures) must seek immediate emergency medical care.
